All Senior Financial Employees shall establish, maintain and support policies and procedures that encourage and reward professional integrity in all aspects of the Company's organization and shall ensure an environment exists within the Company which eliminates inhibitions and barriers to responsible behaviour, such as coercion, fear of reprisal, or alienation from other employees within the Company. Each Senior Financial Employee shall endeavor to comply with all securities or other laws, rules or regulations of U.S. federal, state and local governments and other private and public regulatory authorities that are applicable to the Company and its operations.
